entry.title: New: dsh-skill-curator
entry.summary: Meta-skill for DSH skill experience feedback and knowledge accumulation: feeds fixes back into skills and records a searchable knowledge base (keyword + local bge semantic retrieval, 7-point write-back checklist, anti-bloat archiving), with self-validation and event-hook tools.
